how: A commit cannot name its own hash. The FREEZE commit lands PREREG.md, the eval_fair_puct patch, leg_lib.py, run_cells.sh, adjudicate_smoke.py, the golden gate + TAUP_BITEXACT.json, the tests and the REAL-EMITTER fixture with this field reading PENDING; a SECOND, stamping commit replaces it with the freeze commit's 40-hex sha AND the same sha in WORKERS.conf's BLIND_COMMIT=. `run_cells.sh` REFUSES a real cell while either still says PENDING; --plan / --dry-run / --smoke are EXEMPT (they spend no blindness and no band).
what_is_frozen: PREREG.md — design, the two doses, the bar, the branch map, the gates, the non-inference limits
scripts/classical_search/eval_fair_puct.py — the --cand-tau-p flag (⛔ THE ONE SOURCE EDIT; it stays in the worktree, the orchestrator merges it at a quiet window)
leg_lib.py — the cells, constants and gates, in ONE implementation imported by the launcher, the adjudicator AND the tests
WORKERS.conf — the per-box constants; tests assert it agrees with leg_lib
run_cells.sh — the launcher and its fail-closed precondition ladder
adjudicate_smoke.py — the smoke's self-adjudication from its own emitted manifest
goldengate/ + TAUP_BITEXACT.json — the bit-exact-when-unset / positive-control / candidate-only gate
test_taup_leg.py + selftest_fixture/ — the contract tests and the REAL-EMITTER fixtures

state_at_freeze.dry_cell_disclosure: DEVIATIONS.md D-1 — a 2-game --cand-tau-p 3.0 head-to-head at k2x32 on throwaway seeds 171999999000-1, run to seed the fixture from the REAL emitter and to verify every gate address. Spends no band; emits no outcome that may be read.
state_at_freeze.golden_gate_disclosure: DEVIATIONS.md D-2 — a 4-of-12-seed PREVIEW pass (all 9 checks PASS). The launcher REFUSES to spend a band on it; the full frozen set must be re-run before launch.
